sn35.81:1.1: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || pe || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn35.81:1.2: Idha no bhante aññatitthiyā paribbājakā amhe evam pucchanti ||
sn35.81:1.3: Kim atthi yam āvuso Samane Gotame brahmacariyam vussatīti || ||
sn35.81:1.4: Evam puṭṭhā mayam bhante tesam aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evam vyākaroma ||
sn35.81:1.5: Dukkhassa kho āvuso pariññattham Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti || ||
sn35.81:1.6: Kacci mayam bhante evam puṭṭhā evaṃ vyākaramānā vuttavādino ve Bhagavato homa || na ca Bhagavantam abhūtena abbhācikkhāma || dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākaroma || na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānam āgacchatī ti || || 4
sn35.81:2.1: Taggha tumhe bhikkhave evam puṭṭhā evaṃ vyākaramānā vuttavādino ceva me hotha || na ca mam abhūtena abbhācikkhatha dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākarotha || na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānam āgacchati ||
sn35.81:2.2: Dukkhassa hi bhikkhave pariññattham mayi brahmacariyaṃ vussati || || 5
sn35.81:2.3: Sace pana vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam puccheyyuṃ ||
sn35.81:2.4: Katamam pana tam āvuso dukkhaṃ yassa pariññāya Samaṇe Gotame brahmacariyam vussatīti || ||
sn35.81:2.5: Evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesam aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānam evaṃ vyākareyyātha || || 6-11
sn35.81:2.6: Cakkhuṃ kho āvuso dukkhaṃ || tassa pariññāya Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati ||
sn35.81:2.8: Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjativedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi dukkhaṃ
sn35.81:2.11: Yampidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi dukkhaṃ
sn35.81:2.13: Idaṃ kho tam āvuso dukkhaṃ || tassa pariññāya Bhagavati brahmacariyam vussati || || 12
sn35.81:2.14: Evam puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesam aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evam vyākareyyāthāti || || 2
